item.title: Clerk: fee-start (2027-01-01)
item.description: Clerk Directory Sync connection billing starts 2027-01-01 (same ladder as SSO: 1 included on Pro/Business, then $75 / $60 bands). Announced on clerk.com/pricing.

item.title: AuthCost: coverage-added (2026-10-31)
item.description: Added Firebase Auth / Identity Platform (no cost to 50k MAU, then $0.0055→$0.0025/MAU bands; SAML/OIDC $0.015/MAU after 50) and Descope (Free 7.5k MAU; Pro from $249/mo with 10k MAU + $0.05/MAU; Growth from $799/mo with 25k MAU), read from their official pricing pages. New guide: what self-hosting Better Auth / Auth.js costs instead.

item.title: Clerk: new-tier (2026-10-31)
item.description: Clerk publishes a new enterprise SSO connection band: connections 101–250 now cost $48/mo each (was "Contact us" for 101+). Earlier bands are unchanged: 1 included, $75/mo each for 2–15, $60/mo each for 16–100; 251+ is contact sales.

item.title: Auth0: correction (2026-10-31)
item.description: Correction: our earlier Auth0 data (2026-10-30) listed paid tiers only at 500 MAU and called higher volumes and B2B “custom”. That was wrong — Auth0 publishes MAU tiers: B2C Essentials $70 (1k) to $3,500 (50k)/mo, B2C Professional to $3,200 (20k), B2B Essentials $150 (500) to $3,800 (20k) with 3 SSO connections, B2B Professional $800 to $2,400 (10k) with 5. Billing rounds up to the next tier; yearly = 11× monthly; extra SSO connections $100/mo. Not an Auth0 price change — our omission, now fixed.

item.title: AuthCost: launch-seed (2026-10-30)
item.description: Initial ledger seeded from official pricing pages (Clerk, Auth0, Cognito, WorkOS, Stytch, Logto, Kinde, Supabase Auth).
